passive.name: Revolutionary Chorale
passive.text: A part of the "Millennial Movement" that wanders amidst the winds. Increases DMG by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%**. When the character wielding this weapon triggers Elemental Reactions, they gain a Sigil of Rebellion. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s and can be triggered even if said character is not on the field. When you possess 2 Sigils of Rebellion, all of them will be consumed and all nearby party members will obtain "Millennial Movement: Song of Resistance" for 12s. "Millennial Movement: Song of Resistance" increases Normal, Charged and Plunging Attack DMG by **16/20/24/28/32%** and increases ATK by **20/25/30/35/40%**. Once this effect is triggered, you will not gain Sigils of Rebellion for 20s. Of the many effects of the "Millennial Movement," buffs of the same type will not stack.

passive.name: Composed
passive.text: After damaging an opponent with an Elemental Skill, the skill has a **40/50/60/70/80%** chance to end its own CD. Can only occur once every **30/26/22/19/16**s.

passive.name: Windfall
passive.text: CRIT Hits have a **60/70/80/90/100%** chance to generate a small amount of Elemental Particles, which will regenerate 6 Energy for the character. Can only occur once every **12/10.5/9/7.5/6**s.

passive.name: Infusion Stinger
passive.text: Dealing Elemental DMG increases all DMG by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%** for 6s. Max 2 stacks. Can occur once every 1s.

substatLine: Energy Recharge > Elemental Mastery > Crit Rate > Crit DMG
skillPriority: Elemental Burst > Elemental Skill > Normal Attack

entries.name: Foreign Fieldcleaver
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Razorgrass Blade
entries.text:
With a flourish of your blade, you unleash a spray of razor-sharp leaves that go before you and deal **Dendro DMG**.

You and Paimon observed the flowing edges of grass and leaf.

entries.name: Surgent Manifestation
entries.text:
Calling upon the might of the flora all around you, you create a Lea Lotus Lamp.
This Lamp will deal continuous **Dendro DMG** to opponents within its AoE.

**Lotuslight Transfiguration**
The Lea Lotus Lamp will undergo the following changes after it comes into contact with **Hydro**/**Electro**/**Pyro**:
·**Hydro**: the Lamp's AoE and the AoE of its attacks are increased.
·**Electro**: the Lamp's ATK SPD is increased.
·**Pyro**: the Lamp will explode after a short delay and then disappear, dealing **AoE Dendro DMG**.
The Lea Lotus Lamp can only undergo one Lotuslight Transfiguration in its duration.

Only one Lamp created by the Traveler can exist at any one time.

You and Paimon studied the sounds of plants that sprout after the rain.

entries.name: Verdant Overgrowth
entries.text: **Lea Lotus Lamp** will obtain one level of Overflowing Lotuslight every second it is on the field, increasing the Elemental Mastery of active character(s) within its AoE by 6. Overflowing Lotuslight has a maximum of 10 stacks.

entries.name: Verdant Luxury
entries.text: Every point of Elemental Mastery the Traveler possesses increases the DMG dealt by **Razorgrass Blade** by 0.15% and the DMG dealt by **Surgent Manifestation** by 0.1%.

entries.name: Foreign Verdalume
entries.text:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional **buffs**.

Additionally, when Dendro Cores (including Bountiful Cores, Seeds of Deceit) appear nearby on the field, or when the party obtains Verdant Dew, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis. These two methods can each grant the Traveler up to 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis every 4s, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis and transform into the special **Charged Attack: Verdessence**.

**Charged Attack: Verdessence**
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased **Dendro DMG**. The increase in DMG is equal to 80% of Traveler's ATK. Two **Vinecores** will also be created on the spot, which will explode after 4/8s respectively, inflicting **Dendro DMG** equal to 120% of Traveler's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· **Charged Attack: Verdessence** can be triggered up to once every 15s.

entries.name: Symbiotic Creeper
entries.text: After **Razorgrass Blade** hits an opponent, it will regenerate 3.5 Energy for the Traveler.

entries.name: Green Resilience
entries.text: **Lea Lotus Lamp**'s duration is increased by 3s.

entries.name: Whirling Weeds
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Razorgrass Blade** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Treacle Grass
entries.text:
After the **Lea Lotus Lamp** triggers a Lotuslight Transfiguration, it will obtain 5 stacks of the Overflowing Lotuslight effect from the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."

entries.name: Viridian Transience
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Surgent Manifestation** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Withering Aggregation
entries.text: The **Dendro DMG Bonus** of the character under the effect of Overflowing Lotuslight as created by the **Lea Lotus Lamp** is increased by 12%. If the Lamp has experienced a Lotuslight Transfiguration previously, the character will also gain 12% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element.
